title: Silent Scope
sources: own RAM search with gbaverify (no RA notes): HUD total time 1'03 -> 0'21 -> 0'54 matched minute/second words at 0x030043E8/0x030043EC, and the big stage countdown 16 -> 58 -> 25 a word at 0x03004400

widgets.text:
Health, time, score
Port of Konami's sniper arcade game: you look through a scope to shoot terrorists
Life drops when enemies shoot you; the timer adds pressure between targets

Zoom the scope; time shots carefully
Scope view zooms in; the wide view shows where targets are
Quick headshots score more and save time

Terrorist bosses at stage ends
Each stage ends with a boss terrorist who moves around: lead your shots
Hostages appear in some scenes: shooting them costs you

Stages with hostage scenarios
Stages follow the rescue of the President's daughter from terrorists (arcade storyline)
Route choices appear between some stages

Ammo and reload
Unlimited ammo with reloads; accuracy matters more than speed

Bonus targets
Bonus targets (marked) give extra points and time

Stages cleared
High scores; harder settings make enemies faster
